reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about the microstructure and deformation mechanisms of the WTaTiVZr HEA and pure tungsten, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific grain boundary structure or high-temperature deformation behavior of this novel alloy.
premises: Equimolar WTaTiVZr HEA has distorted, complex grain boundaries

Distorted grain boundaries promote enhanced dislocation nucleation
